# Postmortem writeup

Write a blameless postmortem after an incident with the timeline, root cause, contributing factors and follow-up actions.

## Steps

1. Read the request and confirm the scope.
2. Follow the checklist for this kind of work.
3. Report what changed and how it was verified.
